title: AvailabilityBroadcast (Envelope v2)
description: v2 — sign-what-you-send envelope. The daemon serializes the BroadcastBody to canonical JSON, base64-encodes those exact bytes as bodyB64, and HMACs the DECODED bytes. The verifier base64-decodes, re-HMACs the same bytes, and compares in constant time. No cross-language JSON field-ordering assumptions. Carries no observation values; the target pulls the full IndicatorDataset by datasetId after accept.

bodyB64.description: base64 (RFC 4648) of the canonical BroadcastBody JSON bytes the daemon signed.

keyId.description: Identifies the signing key in the verifier's trust set. Enables rotation (and a later Ed25519 upgrade) without an envelope reshuffle.

value.description: hex HMAC-SHA256 over the DECODED bodyB64 bytes, keyed by the daemon secret. Authenticates the daemon to the target.
